# infisical_pam_account_group (Resource)

Manage a group's membership in a PAM account, which grants its role on the account. The group must already be a PAM member. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_group" "solengs" {
  group_id = "<group-id>"
  role     = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_group" "solengs_pamadmin" {
  account_id = "<account-id>"
  group_id   = infisical_pam_group.solengs.group_id # also makes Terraform add the group to PAM first
  role       = "operator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The ID of the PAM account. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `role` (String) The role on the account: `admin`, `operator` (sessions and credentials), `connector` (sessions only) or `auditor` (audit logs and recordings).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the membership.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the group's account membership by account ID and group ID
terraform import infisical_pam_account_group.example <account_id>:<group_id>
```
